name: Air Fryer Parmesan Asparagus "Fries" with Dill-Yogurt Dipping Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
½ lemon
¼ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs and Parmesan in a medium bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¼ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Place egg, flour, and spices in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 egg
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; halve crosswise.

Working in batches, add asparagus to the bowl with the egg mixture. Allow excess to drip off, then add to the bowl with the bread crumbs and Parmesan. Turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere, then transfer to a large plate.

Coat the bottom of the air fryer basket with cooking spray. Arrange asparagus fries in the basket, leaving space between each piece, and layering so each level is perpendicular to the last. Coat with more cooking spray. (Work in batches, if necessary, to accommodate the size of your air fryer basket.)
Insert basket into air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook, shaking gently halfway through, until asparagus is tender and coating is crisp, 10-12 minutes. Remove from air fryer.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dipping sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tsp Dijon mustard
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange asparagus fries on a platter and serve with dipping sauce on the side. Enjoy!
